name: catalog-favourites-simple
description: Simple ladder for catalog favourites: verify the star button appears on catalog cards, toggling it adds items to the Favourites tab, the tab count updates, and persistence survives a store clear (simulating reload). Checks visibility in both Simple and Pro modes.

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-simple-mode
steps.failMessage: App did not boot in Simple mode

steps.name: verify-star-chip-visible-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const starChips = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cat-rail .chip')].filter(b => b.querySelector('svg') && !b.textContent?.includes('Rec')); if (starChips.length === 0) throw new Error('Favourites star chip not found in cat-rail — catalogFavourites flag may be off in Simple mode'); })()

steps.name: verify-fav-buttons-on-cards
steps.eval: (function(){ const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.cat-card'); const favBtns = document.querySelectorAll('.fav-btn'); if (favBtns.length === 0) throw new Error('No .fav-btn found on catalog cards — star button missing'); console.log('Found', favBtns.length, 'fav buttons across', cards.length, 'cards'); })()

steps.name: verify-two-favourited
steps.failMessage: Expected 2 favourites after starring two items

steps.name: click-favourites-tab
steps.eval: (function(){ const chips = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cat-rail .chip')]; const starChip = chips.find(c => !c.textContent?.trim() || c.textContent?.trim().replace(/[0-9]/g,'') === ''); if (!starChip) { console.log('chips:', chips.map(c=>c.textContent)); } else { starChip.click(); } })()

steps.name: verify-favourites-shows-items
steps.eval: (function(){ const cards = document.querySelectorAll('.card-grid .cat-card'); if (cards.length < 2) throw new Error('Expected at least 2 items in the Favourites view, found: ' + cards.length); console.log('Favourites view shows', cards.length, 'cards'); })()

steps.name: verify-persistence-test
steps.eval: (function(){ const raw = localStorage.getItem('hdb_favourites'); const saved = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : []; if (!saved.includes('armchair') || !saved.includes('sofa-3seat')) throw new Error('Favourites not persisted to localStorage. Got: ' + JSON.stringify(saved)); console.log('localStorage hdb_favourites:', saved); })()

steps.name: verify-empty-hint-shown
steps.eval: (function(){ const emptyMsg = document.querySelector('.empty-mini'); if (!emptyMsg) throw new Error('Empty state message not shown when favourites is empty'); console.log('Empty message text:', emptyMsg.textContent?.trim()); })()

steps.name: verify-star-chip-visible-pro
steps.eval: (function(){ const starChips = [...document.querySelectorAll('.cat-rail .chip')].filter(b => b.querySelector('svg') && !b.textContent?.includes('Rec')); if (starChips.length === 0) throw new Error('Favourites star chip not found in Pro mode'); })()
